workflow: Discussion phases are warranted when there are unresolved design decisions (Sentry vs self-hosted, decomposition boundaries); plan+execute is sufficient when implementation path is clear

Concerns were triaged into four waves: quick wins, high-impact infrastructure, structural refactors, and ongoing test coverage — with some items explicitly marked as not worth addressing
